title: Place Value Introduction (Units to Thousands)
description: Visual explanation of place value and digit values from ones up to thousands for primary math students.

title: Identify Place Value up to 1,00,000 Practice
description: Interactive practice identifying place values, periods, and face value in 4-digit and 5-digit numbers.

title: Addition with Regrouping (Carrying Over)
description: Step-by-step method for adding 3-digit and 4-digit numbers with carrying across place value columns.

title: Subtraction with Regrouping (Borrowing Across Zeros)
description: Clear walkthrough of subtraction with regrouping, decomposing higher place values and borrowing across zeros.

title: Intro to 3-Digit Addition with Regrouping
description: Fundamental lessons on 3-digit addition strategies with visual block representations for Grade 3 and 4.

title: NCERT Class 4 Math Chapter 1: Building with Bricks
description: Official NCERT textbook chapter covering brick patterns, counting in thousands, and place value concepts.

title: Place Value Introduction in Hindi (स्थानीय मान)
description: इकाई, दहाई, सैकड़ा और हज़ार के स्थानीय मान की अवधारणा को हिंदी में आसान उदाहरणों से समझाता वीडियो।

title: Addition with Regrouping in Hindi (हासिल वाले जोड़)
description: तीन अंकों वाली संख्याओं के हासिल वाले जोड़ (पुनर्समूहन) को हिंदी में विस्तार से समझाने वाला वीडियो पाठ।

title: NCERT Class 4 Ganit Ka Jadu (गणित का जादू) Textbook
description: कक्षा 4 की एनसीईआरटी गणित पुस्तक 'गणित का जादू' - स्थानीय मान, जोड़-घटाना और संख्या संक्रियाएं।

title: DIKSHA Primary Math: Place Value & Operations
description: సంఖ్యామానం, స్థాన విలువ మరియు ప్రాథమిక కూడికలు తీసివేతలపై దీక్షా పోర్టల్ డిజిటల్ లెర్నింగ్ రిసోర్స్.

title: Multiplication Tables 2 to 10 Mastery
description: Visual patterns and memorization tricks for multiplication tables 2 through 10 with repeated addition.

title: Multiplying 2-Digit and 3-Digit Numbers
description: Step-by-step standard algorithm for multiplying 2-digit numbers by 1-digit and 2-digit multipliers.

title: Multiply by Multiples of 10 Practice
description: Practice mentally multiplying whole numbers by 10, 20, 100, and using place value zeros effectively.

title: Multi-Digit Multiplication Introduction
description: Comprehensive explanation of multi-digit multiplication, column alignment, partial products, and carrying.

title: Multiplication as Repeated Addition
description: Foundational conceptual video demonstrating how equal groups and repeated addition define multiplication.

title: NCERT Class 5 Math: Ways to Multiply and Divide
description: Official NCERT Chapter covering Bela's method, box multiplication, and real-life multiplication problems.

title: Multiplication Tables in Hindi (पहाड़े 2 से 10)
description: 2 से 10 तक के गणितीय पहाड़े (गुणा तालिका) और उनके पैटर्न को आसान भाषा में सिखाने वाला वीडियो।

title: Multiplication Concept in Hindi (गुणा की अवधारणा)
description: बार-बार जोड़ने के रूप में गुणा को चित्रों और उदाहरणों की मदद से समझाने वाला हिंदी पाठ।

title: Multi-Digit Multiplication in Hindi (बड़ी संख्याओं का गुणा)
description: दो और तीन अंकों वाली संख्याओं के गुणनफल और मानक विधि (कॉलम गुणन) का हिंदी वीडियो ट्यूटोरियल।

title: DIKSHA Primary Math: Multiplication & Tables
description: గుణకార భావన, ఎక్కములు మరియు బహుళ అంకెల గుణకారాలపై దీక్షా పోర్టల్ సమగ్ర అభ్యాస వనరు.

title: Division as Equal Sharing and Grouping
description: Visual introduction to division as fair sharing and repeated subtraction using concrete groups.

title: Division with Remainder Introduction
description: How to interpret quotients and remainders when objects cannot be divided equally into whole groups.

title: Long Division with 2-Digit Divisor
description: Step-by-step method for dividing 3-digit and 4-digit numbers by 2-digit numbers with quotient estimation.

title: Word Problems on Multiplication and Division
description: Applied word problems to help students distinguish between grouping (multiplication) and sharing (division).

title: Divide by 2-Digit Numbers Exercise
description: Interactive long division practice problems with instant feedback and hints for Class 5 students.

title: NCERT Class 5 Math: Tables and Shares (Division)
description: Official NCERT textbook chapter featuring equal sharing, division algorithms, and word problems.

title: Division Concept in Hindi (बराबर बाँटना और भाग)
description: समान बंटवारे और समूहों में बांटने के रूप में भाग की अवधारणा को स्पष्ट करने वाला हिंदी वीडियो।

title: Long Division in Hindi (लंबी भाग विधि)
description: दो अंकों की संख्या से भाग देने की लंबी विधि, भागफल और शेषफल निकालने का हिंदी में चरणबद्ध तरीका।

title: NCERT Class 5 Ganit Chapter: गुणा और भाग के तरीके
description: एनसीईआरटी कक्षा 5 गणित का पाठ 'गुणा और भाग के तरीके' - दैनिक जीवन में भाग के उपयोग और उदाहरण।

title: DIKSHA Primary Math: Division Concepts & Practice
description: సమాన విభజన, భాగహార భావన మరియు లెక్కలపై దీక్షా పోర్టల్ డిజిటల్ లెర్నింగ్ వర్క్‌షీట్.

title: Introduction to Fractions (Halves and Quarters)
description: Visual foundation of fractions showing numerator, denominator, half, one-third, and one-quarter parts.

title: Equivalent Fractions Visual Tutorial
description: Understanding equivalent fractions with visual fraction strips, rectangles, and multiplication rules.

title: Comparing Fractions with Like and Unlike Denominators
description: How to compare fractions with equal numerators, equal denominators, or using common denominators.

title: Adding and Subtracting Fractions with Like Denominators
description: Step-by-step guide for combining fractions having the same denominator with visual pie models.

title: Equivalent Fractions Interactive Exercise
description: Interactive problem set to test finding missing numerators and denominators for equivalent fractions.

title: NCERT Class 5 Math Chapter 4: Parts and Wholes
description: Official NCERT textbook chapter 'Parts and Wholes' introducing fraction concepts through stories and activities.

title: Fractions Intro in Hindi (भिन्न की समझ - आधे और चौथाई)

title: Comparing Fractions in Hindi (भिन्नों की तुलना)

title: NCERT Class 5 Ganit: हिस्से और पूरे (Parts & Wholes)

title: Halves and Quarters Introduction (భాగములు మరియు భిన్నాలు)

title: Ways to Multiply and Divide (గుణకార మరియు భాగహార పద్ధతులు)
